why_split: The two shots are separate episodes (the 1940 civilian evacuation from Gibraltar and the 1942 Torch landings) with different dates, legends and arrow logic, so the cut resets the viewer cleanly. The X5 transition glitch (ghost label, floating arrowheads) needs fixing, and each shot needs a longer hold.
top_fix: Mark Casablanca, Oran, Algiers, London, Madeira and Jamaica with pins on the map, and draw the routes in a high-contrast color with end markers. Remove overlapping callouts, and clean the X5 crossfade so the old label doesn't ghost in. Add camera motion or route growth for the whole shot instead of holding a static frame.
